blocks.text: Static application datasets allow you to configure the front ends of web applications that are deployed using Threat Intelligence (TI) decoys and network decoys via web services. These datasets consist of static HTML files, CSS files, JavaScript files, etc. that can be used as an interface to engage adversaries submitting credentials or performing text-based web application attacks.
Static application datasets provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure the front ends that mimic legitimate web applications to lure attackers.
Deploy network decoys of TI decoys with static web applications.
Creating responsive web application decoys by associating them with dynamic applications or high-interaction applications.

blocks.heading: About the Static Application Datasets Page

blocks.text: On the Static Application Datasets page (Miragemaker > Static Application Datasets), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the list of prepopulated and custom static application datasets, and search for a specific entry by name.
Configure a custom static application dataset.
Edit or delete a static application dataset.
